The public Skill supports sync/task management, not Savault Q&A MCP. The current desktop app and Obsidian plugin include Ask Your Collections. The Agent Skill installer pins its Windows and Mac runtime to 0.1.6.

Pinned Skill runtime release, Windows / Mac 0.1.6: https://github.com/lin113311221/savault-skills/releases/tag/desktop-v0.1.6
Local folder guide: https://github.com/lin113311221/savault-skills/blob/main/docs/local-folder.md
Windows and Mac GUI+CLI support local Markdown / Notion / Obsidian. No Savault Q&A MCP.
